linked_prs.title: 🐛 fix: add qwen provider support for image-edit model
linked_prs.body:
## Summary
- Register qwen provider in baseRuntimeMap to enable native support
- Add qwen routing in NewAPI provider (detects "ali" owned_by field)  
- Implement qwen-image-edit model with correct multimodal-generation API

## What's Changed
### 1. Native Qwen Provider Support
- Added `LobeQwenAI` to `baseRuntimeMap` enabling direct qwen provider usage without proxy

### 2. NewAPI Routing Enhancement  
- Detect qwen models via `owned_by === 'ali'` (NewAPI's actual channel name)
- Route qwen models to correct provider instead of defaulting to OpenAI

### 3. Image-Edit Model Implementation
- Use correct API endpoint: `/services/aigc/multimodal-generation/generation`
- Implement proper request format with messages structure
- Handle synchronous response (no polling required)
- Remove hardcoded watermark parameter (defaults to false)

## Related Issue
Fixes #9184 - qwen-image-edit model not working via NewAPI

## Test Plan
- [x] Unit tests: All 24 qwen provider tests pass
- [x] NewAPI tests: All 44 tests pass  
- [x] Type checking: No TypeScript errors
- [x] Backward compatibility: Existing qwen models continue to work

## Summary by Sourcery

Enable native Qwen provider support and implement the qwen-image-edit model, integrating it into the runtime map and NewAPI router while adding synchronous image-edit workflows and corresponding tests.

New Features:
- Register LobeQwenAI in baseRuntimeMap for direct Qwen provider usage
- Enhance NewAPI router to detect and route Qwen models based on owned_by and supported_endpoint_types
- Implement qwen-image-edit model using the multimodal-generation/generation endpoint for synchronous image editing

Bug Fixes:
- Fix qwen-image-edit model not working via NewAPI (fix #9184)

Tests:
- Add unit tests for qwen-image-edit covering success, missing imageUrl, and error scenarios

ai_judgment.response: Yes. The issue involves integrating the `qwen-image-edit` model from 阿里云百炼 via newapi, which aligns with the "Unsupported models" sub-category under "Incompatibility with LLM providers," as the agent system fails to work with this specific LLM model.
